description_en: Call the DescribeConfigHistory operation to view the configuration parameter change history of a community-compatible ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeConfigHistory接口查看云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群配置参数的变更记录
name: DescribeConfigHistory

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to query the information about all clusters in a specific region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html接口查询目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. Use the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Use the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

ConfigHistoryItems.description_en: The change history of the configuration parameters

ChangeId.description_en: The ID of the change record

OwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account

Reason.description_en: The reason for the parameter change

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the parameter change took effect. Valid values:

true: The change took effect.

false: The change did not take effect
Success.description_zh:
配置参数的变更是否生效。取值说明：
true：生效。
false：未生效

Time.description_en: The time when the change was made. Use the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC
